title: Two-sum in one pass
prompt: Implement `std::vector<int> two_sum(const std::vector<int>& nums, int target)` returning the indices `[i, j]` (i < j) of the two numbers adding to target, or an empty vector when no pair exists. The one-pass hash-map approach is O(n): before inserting nums[i], check whether `target - nums[i]` was already seen.

tests.name: basic
later-pair
tests.hint: 3 + 3 would reuse index 0 — the pair is 2 + 4.

tests.name: duplicates
tests.hint: Two equal values still form a valid pair.
